dependency_edges.handoff: Adoption and EV totals feed the global vehicle and scenario forecast.
Projected EV counts scale type-specific operational emissions.
Total vehicles and EV shares define paired fleet-emission scenarios.
Environmental and health savings become DEA benefit outputs.
Projected total and EV/CV counts feed both fossil-fuel scenarios.
Residual upstream pollution motivates cleaner generation shares.
Social/environment/business/individual priorities motivate the four AHP dimensions.
AHP weights parameterize the first-order grid objective.
